## About
Sun City Card Club is a poker room on the east side of El Paso. We run live games, VIP games and a full tournament schedule, and you will not pay any club access fee to sit down.
We keep the room legal, safe and fun for every member, and we don't let anyone bend our compliance rules. That's how a card room stays a place people want to come back to.
Visitors from out of town have written about how welcome they felt at our tables. We're rated 4.5 from 35 Google reviews, and we'd like to deal you in next.

## Services
- Weekly guaranteed tournaments: Guaranteed tournaments run every week. Each one needs at least 25 players.
- High roller freezeout: A $300 freezeout with $50 bounties, held on the last Saturday of each month.
- Ladies night freeroll: A freeroll for the ladies on the first Friday of each month.

## FAQ
Q: Do you hold monthly tournaments?
A: Yes. Along with the weekly schedule, we run monthly tournaments.

Q: Are drinks and snacks available?
A: One reviewer mentioned free drinks, snacks and beer, and said food is served on occasion.

## What customers say
- "Update 9/1/26
This tells you all you need to know about the quality of people playing at Sun City. Last night I made one of my visits around 10:30 after dinner with clients. The table was full, no big deal. Yet one of the regular players known as " The Principal" jumps up and offers me his seat so this traveling visitor can get into the action packed game. As appreciative as I was I couldn't take the man's seat as I knew by his stack he was stuck.

Great room, great owner, great players and incredible action! Thank you Sun City for always making feel at home.

..................................

I stumbled into Sun City the first time as a result of another card room not having a seat for 45 minutes. Since that first visit to Sun City I have been welcomed like an old lost friend. I haven't played in any other card rooms in El Paso as I am treated too good by the staff and the 2 owners. Great action, great people equals a great poker experience. Keep it up Sun City as you have impressed this former restaurant owner immensely." (Steve Sleasman, 5/5)
- "Pretty nice and clean poker room overall. They have some great promotions like you get $100 added to your stack. If you're one of the first six players to show up each day. They also have other promotions like aces cracked and flush frenzy. They have free drinks and snacks as well as free beer. Occasionally they serve food also. I would say check them out if you're in the El Paso area!" (David Peltz, 5/5)
